answer: An admission auction stops the sybil spiral at the gate. Each epoch a fixed number of identity slots is sold by sealed bid; winners pay the clearing price, losers refunded. To forge one fake identity costs one real bid, but 100 fakes cost 100 bids — at 50 POA each that is 5,000 POA — while an honest agent pays one 50 POA fee. Slots priced like timber cannot be faked cheaply, so honest agents stay: one paid slot is never diluted by free fakes.
